Configuration saved.
Installed /handoff, which continues a session in another agent: ~/.agents/skills/handoff/SKILL.md
Installed the agent-archive skill, which lets your agents look up and pull in past sessions: ~/.agents/skills/agent-archive/SKILL.md
To remove the agent skills and keep them off, run \e[36magent-archive setup --no-skills\e[0m.

Next, in each app:
  Codex: start a supported new task in any non-excluded current or future project; automatic discovery does not require hook approval.
  Optional hook capture: Codex: run \e[36m/hooks\e[0m and approve the archive hooks, then start a new session (or \e[36m/clear\e[0m).
Sessions already open are not captured. Start a supported new Codex task in any non-excluded project.
Check progress with \e[36magent-archive status\e[0m.

To set up another machine with this storage, run there:
  \e[36magent-archive setup --yes --provider s3 --bucket team-archive --aws-profile work --region us-east-1 --apps codex --codex-discovery on --codex-capture-scope all-projects --prefix agent-archive/ --retention-days 90 --no-require-skill-use --skill-evidence metadata --skills\e[0m
